previous_chunk_tail: . - Stored on the server. - Last until the browser is closed. - Can store larger amounts of data. What is PHP File Handling? What is a Cookie in PHP? A cookie is a small piece of data stored on the user's computer by the browser. It is created by the server and sent to the browser when you visit a website. Next time you visit, the browser sends the cookie back to the server. This helps websites remember login details, preferences, or last visit info. Cookies act like a memory for websites. How Cookies Work (Step by Step) 1 The server sends a cookie to the user's browser. 2 The browser saves the cookie on the user's computer. 3 When the user visits again, the browser sends the cookie back. 4 The server reads the cookie and recognizes the user. In short: Cookies help websites 'remember' you.
